item.title: Identity Domain
item.description: What is an identity domain? An identity domain (idd) is an explicit namespace for a principal. Two users named user1 can belong to different domains. The string is supplied by trusted integration code or a configured token asserter; it is not proof of authentication. Speedle does not infer or validate a provider’s tenant model merely from the domain name. item.title: Token asserter
item.description: Evaluation requests can contain an identity token that represents a user. In this case, the evaluation engine can invoke the asserter service to obtain the explicit identities of the user
